title: Create web extensions for Safari
description: Get started with Safari web extensions by building and testing one from the ground up — no Xcode required. Explore how content blocking, page modification, native messaging, and the permissions mode work together to create a powerful, privacy-preserving browsing experience across platforms.

codeSnippets.code:
let script = {
    id: "id",
    js: [ "content.js" ],
    css: [ "content.css" ],
    matches: [ "*://*.webkit.org/*" ],
    persistAcrossSessions: true
}

await browser.scripting.registerContentScripts([ script ])
